e.summary: 北美精算师协会官方路径入口：ASA/FSA/CERA 资格、考纲与要求、历年真题与解答、VEE、UCAP/CAE
e.summary_en: The Society of Actuaries’ official pathway portal: ASA/FSA/CERA designations, exam requirements, past exams and solutions, VEE, UCAP/CAE
e.summary_hk: 北美精算師協會官方路徑入口：ASA/FSA/CERA 資格、考綱與要求、歷年真題與解答、VEE、UCAP/CAE
e.body: SOA（Society of Actuaries，北美精算师协会）官方教育入口（`soa.org/education/overview/`）是**整条北美精算资格路径的权威起点**，站内结构可核实且完整：**Future Actuaries**（What is an Actuary / Why Become an Actuary / How to Become an Actuary）、**Education & Exams**（**Exams & Requirements** 考试与要求、University Resources、Educational Pathways）、三大资格 **ASA（准精算师）/ FSA（正精算师）/ CERA（特许企业风险分析师）** 与 Micro-Credentials、**Exam Registration 与 Exam Results**、**Past Exams and Solutions（历年真题与解答）**、**VEE（Validation by Educational Experience，教育经历认证）**、以及面向院校的 **UCAP（Universities & Colleges with Actuarial Programs）**、**CAE（Centers of Actuarial Excellence）** 与 **UEC（University-Earned Credit，校内学分抵免）** 计划、**Hickman Scholars** 奖学金；研究侧另有 **Artificial Intelligence** 与 **Catastrophe and Climate** 等研究专题。对 RIAA：这是**「要考什么、怎么抵免、真题在哪」的唯一权威来源**——特别是 **Past Exams and Solutions** 与 **UEC/VEE** 两块，前者是备考的核心材料，后者决定岭大/RIM 课程能否抵免考试；与 [[soa-jobs]]（就业）、[[soa-practice-tools]]（实务工具）、[[soa-exam-pa-r-doc]]（PA 科目 R 文档）、[[actuarial-exam-database]] 搭配可覆盖「路径 → 材料 → 工具」；与 [[ifoa-studying]]、[[cas-syllabus]] 构成三大体系的官方对照，区域性资格见 [[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]；适合作考试规划、资格路径与院校抵免方向。
e.body_en: The SOA’s (Society of Actuaries) official education portal (`soa.org/education/overview/`) is **the authoritative starting point for the entire North American actuarial qualification pathway**, with a verifiable and complete structure: **Future Actuaries** (What is an Actuary / Why Become an Actuary / How to Become an Actuary), **Education & Exams** (**Exams & Requirements**, University Resources, Educational Pathways), the three designations **ASA / FSA / CERA** plus Micro-Credentials, **Exam Registration and Exam Results**, **Past Exams and Solutions**, **VEE (Validation by Educational Experience)**, and for universities **UCAP (Universities & Colleges with Actuarial Programs)**, **CAE (Centers of Actuarial Excellence)**, the **UEC (University-Earned Credit)** programme and the **Hickman Scholars** programme; on the research side there are dedicated topics for **Artificial Intelligence** and **Catastrophe and Climate**. For RIAA: the single authoritative source for "**what must be examined, how credits transfer, and where the past papers are**" — especially **Past Exams and Solutions** and **UEC/VEE**, the former being core revision material and the latter determining whether Lingnan/RIM courses can earn exemptions; it pairs with [[soa-jobs]] (employment), [[soa-practice-tools]] (practice tools), [[soa-exam-pa-r-doc]] (Exam PA R documentation) and [[actuarial-exam-database]] to cover "pathway → material → tools"; with [[ifoa-studying]] and [[cas-syllabus]] it forms an official three-system comparison, and regional qualifications are covered by [[ashk]], [[actuaries-institute]] and [[singapore-actuarial-society]]; suits exam planning, qualification pathways and university credit transfer.
e.body_hk: SOA（Society of Actuaries，北美精算師協會）官方教育入口（`soa.org/education/overview/`）是**整條北美精算資格路徑的權威起點**，站內結構可核實且完整：**Future Actuaries**、**Education & Exams**（**Exams & Requirements**、University Resources、Educational Pathways）、三大資格 **ASA / FSA / CERA** 與 Micro-Credentials、**Exam Registration 與 Exam Results**、**Past Exams and Solutions（歷年真題與解答）**、**VEE（教育經歷認證）**、以及面向院校的 **UCAP**、**CAE** 與 **UEC（校內學分抵免）** 計劃、**Hickman Scholars** 獎學金；研究側另有 **Artificial Intelligence** 與 **Catastrophe and Climate** 專題。對 RIAA：這是**「要考什麼、怎麼抵免、真題在哪」的唯一權威來源**——特別是 **Past Exams and Solutions** 與 **UEC/VEE**；與 [[soa-jobs]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[soa-exam-pa-r-doc]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]] 搭配可覆蓋「路徑 → 材料 → 工具」；與 [[ifoa-studying]]、[[cas-syllabus]] 構成三大體系的官方對照；適合作考試規劃、資格路徑與院校抵免方向。
